runs.summary: Total group spending is ₹30,900 across 5 transactions.
runs.observation: Accommodation (villa rental) accounts for nearly half (47%) of the total spending.
runs.suggestion: Confirm if all group members participated in optional activities like water sports before splitting costs equally.

runs.summary: Total group spending is 9,149 INR across 4 household utility and maintenance items.
runs.observation: Maid and cleaning service is the highest expense, accounting for roughly 49% of the overall total.
runs.suggestion: Consider setting up a recurring monthly budget for essential bills to manage regular household costs efficiently.

runs.summary: Total group spending is ₹10,570 across food, drinks, and transport.
runs.observation: Alcohol and cocktails accounted for over 58% of the total outing cost.
runs.suggestion: Look for happy hour deals or set a drinks budget to keep group outing expenses lower.

runs.summary: Total group spending is ₹12,140 across 4 transactions over two days.
runs.observation: Transportation (fuel and toll) accounts for the largest share of the budget at ₹5,600 (around 46%).
runs.suggestion: Collect upfront contributions for major fixed costs like transport to streamline group settlements.

runs.observation: All three purchases occurred within a 90-minute window on October 4, 2026, likely for event or meal preparation.
runs.suggestion: Consolidate grocery shopping into a single supermarket trip where possible to simplify expense logging.

runs.summary: Total group spending is ₹6,400 across 3 entertainment activities.
runs.observation: All expenses occurred during a single evening, with snacks making up over 25% of the total budget.
runs.suggestion: Consider pre-booking snack combos or looking for off-peak game discounts to lower outing costs.

runs.observation: The rooftop dinner represents the largest expense, accounting for over 68% of the total budget.
runs.suggestion: Consider splitting the costs evenly among attendees while exempting the person celebrating their birthday.

runs.summary: Total group spending is ₹2,270 across 3 cafe transactions.
runs.observation: All expenses are focused on morning coffee and quick breakfast/snack items.
runs.suggestion: Consider a weekly budget or coffee subscription to lower recurring cafe costs.

runs.summary: Total spending is 8,000 INR across 3 home services.
runs.observation: All three expenses occurred on October 21, 2026, indicating a comprehensive single-day cleaning drive.
runs.suggestion: Consider booking bundled home service packages in the future to save on individual cleaning fees.

runs.summary: Total spending for the trip is ₹10,900 across 3 expenses.
runs.observation: Entry tickets were the main expense, accounting for over 66% of the total cost.
runs.suggestion: Look for online combo packages including tickets and meals to save on future amusement park visits.
